notes.title: Update 0.1.7
notes.content:
Hi everyone !

Based on your feedbacks, we launch the update 0.1.7.
What changes ?
So :
-We added a "Sell all" button, you don't have to enter an amount anymore.
-The IdleCoin price is less variable to the up (too easy before...)
-Upgrades are now effective at 25% !

Thanks to every players and the community !
We'll be back soon.

BovinoSoftware.

notes.title: You can play !
notes.content:
Here we are !
The game is finally out, have fun and let us know your feedback!

Currently we are already working on our next title, and as much to say that it will delight fans of survival ~

In short, good game, see you next time!
BovinoSoftware.

notes.title: Early access !
notes.content:
Hi all !

IdleCoin comes out in a week! And to thank you for your patience, we are going to offer some of you early access to the game!

You just need to fill out this form:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1qC0XdoThMZN64QQwHN04_InqL7Qyub6IEyxinY0KJno/viewform?edit_requested=true

Then if you are drawn, we will send you your key by the means of communication you have given, as easy as that!

Good luck and see you soon !

BovinoSoftware.

notes.title: Release in 8 days !
notes.content:
The countdown is on, IdleCoin is out in 8 days!

We really hope you like the game and have fun.
Until release, we're working on the next content updates and hope you enjoy it too.

Your ideas for Additions / modifications are always welcome, you can follow those in progress at this address: https://trello.com/b/LKjCX8c3/idlecoin-roadmap

Please feel free to add the game to your wishlist and see you soon!

BovinoSoftware.

notes.title: Wishlist and Roadmap
notes.content:
Hi everyone !

We glad to announce the game will be available on December 21st, don't forget to wishlist it !

We will also start to work on new features and what players want in the next update.
You can follow the roadmap here : https://trello.com/b/LKjCX8c3/idlecoin-roadmap
You can even make your feedback and maybe you'll see the content YOU want in the next update ;)

Thank you very much and see you soon !

BovinoSoftware.
